clarity_findings.problem: guide-map.md §8 (linking plan) specifies inserting exactly: "The planet's other tiles need it first. See [[infrastructure-building]]." The live page instead reads: "A planet's other tiles need its infrastructure building first. See [[infrastructure-building]]." This is a rewrite (determiner "The"→"A", pronoun "it"→"its infrastructure building"), not the assigned text. The round's own scope statement says this page "only received links (and at most a term or label change) in this run" — swapping a pronoun for a repeated noun phrase and changing the sentence's determiner is a rewording, not a link or a simple term/label swap, so it falls outside the authorized scope for this round even though the meaning is essentially preserved and the appended [[infrastructure-building]] link itself is correct and resolves properly.
clarity_findings.fix: Either revert the sentence to the assigned wording ("The planet's other tiles need it first. See [[infrastructure-building]].") or, if the reviser's rewording is preferred for clarity, get it explicitly approved/recorded as a wording change rather than let it stand as an undocumented deviation from the linking plan — so later re-diffs against guide-map.md don't misreport this page as fully matching its assigned edit.

rebuttals.finding: must_fix: the second assigned edit should use the linking plan's exact wording ("The planet's other tiles need it first. See [[infrastructure-building]].") or be recorded as an approved change.
rebuttals.evidence: This is the record the finding asks for: the exact wording cannot stand on this page. (1) At its assigned spot, after 'Only an infrastructure building goes there.', it breaks the next sentence. I applied it there temporarily and rendered --text, and the page read: 'Only an infrastructure building goes there. The planet's other tiles need it first. See Infrastructure first. That is the Megapolis on a habitable planet and the Central Hub on a barren planet.' 'That is' now refers to the link, not to the infrastructure building. (2) The only other spot is after the 'That is ...' sentence. There, 'The planet' and 'it' come right after 'the Central Hub on a barren planet', so a player can read the rule as covering barren planets only. The code applies it to both planet types. stellar_system.ex:378-380 throws :no_building_without_infra when the body's biome is not :orbital, the tile id is above 1 and tile 1 is empty. I ran tmp/help-review/stellar-bodies-reviser-infra.exs, ordering a level 1 building on tile 2 with tile 1 empty. habitable_planet (hab_open_poor): {:error, :no_building_without_infra}. With infra_open on tile 1: :ok. sterile_planet (mine_dome): {:error, :no_building_without_infra}. With infra_dome on tile 1: :ok. moon and asteroid (factory_orbital), tile 1 empty: :ok for both. So the only word change is 'The'/'it' becoming 'A'/'its infrastructure building', which says which building is meant and keeps the rule true for both planet types. The link target is the one the plan assigned (infrastructure-building, rendered /help/buildings#infrastructure-first). Record this in guide-map §8 so later checks against the plan don't flag this page. Only the orchestrator can do that, because this reviser may edit stellar-bodies.md alone.
